description: Get a live swap quote — rate, amountUserReceives, network fee, min/max. Always display amountUserReceives (not amountTo). mode="fixed" locks the rate and returns a short-lived rateId. The result includes swapUrl, a ghostswap.io link with this pair and amount filled in that the user can open to swap themselves.

amountFrom.description: Decimal amount as a STRING (e.g. "0.01"). Strings preserve precision.

mode.description: Float (default) settles at market; fixed locks via rateId.

name: get_quote
title: Get a live swap quote
